scripts.build: astro build && npm run copy-php && npm run copy-dist2
scripts.copy-php: copyfiles -u 1 src/api/**/* dist/ && copyfiles -u 1 vendor/**/* dist/api/vendor/ && copyfiles composer.json composer.lock dist/api && copyfiles .htaccess dist2
scripts.copy-dist2: copyfiles -u 1 dist/**/* dist2/ && copyfiles dist/.env dist2/api/
